charts.title: NGTS-34 b: orbits around NGTS-34
charts.description: The orbits of NGTS-34's planets in this map from above, to scale, with NGTS-34 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Kendall et al. 2026 (2026MNRAS.547f2189K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KENDALL_ET_AL_2026): P 43.12655 d
